purpose: Authoritative inventory of ClusterLens durable commit boundaries and fault evidence.

linux.reason: Every declared Linux operation/fault class is covered by a deterministic disposable-fixture regression. Native platform semantics remain separate.

windows.reason: Native sharing-violation, ACL, rename and locked-file behavior requires a Windows host or VM.

macos.reason: Native permission, rename, filesystem and package behavior requires a macOS host if macOS remains advertised.

operations.commit_model: atomic artifacts followed by a checksum manifest readiness commit

boundaries.outcome: An old readiness manifest is absent before replacement artifacts are written.
Vectors/path map/optional FAISS files may exist but are not a usable index without a valid manifest.
Checksummed artifacts become one ready generation.

operations.precommit_cancel: No replacement generation is ready; ensure_index rebuilds it.
operations.postcommit_cancel: The complete checksummed generation remains ready.
operations.committed_subset: None: readiness is the complete manifest, never an artifact subset.
operations.recovery_action: Reject invalid/missing manifests and rebuild the generation.

boundaries.outcome: No rows from the current bounded batch are durable.
Every row in the current bounded batch is durable and reported.

operations.precommit_cancel: Roll back the current batch and report no rows from it.
operations.postcommit_cancel: Finish bounded bookkeeping and return the committed metrics.
operations.committed_subset: Exactly the completed SQLite batches and their image paths.
operations.recovery_action: Reopen SQLite; transaction atomicity exposes either zero or the complete batch.

operations.commit_model: asset and FTS rows in one bounded SQLite transaction

boundaries.outcome: Neither asset nor FTS rows from the batch are visible.
The complete batch and its FTS text are visible.

operations.precommit_cancel: The open batch rolls back; earlier batches remain and are reported exactly.
operations.postcommit_cancel: The committed batch remains and its exact statistics are published.
operations.recovery_action: Reopen the catalog and refresh from the active registered root.

operations.commit_model: sibling temporary file, fsync, atomic replace and directory sync

boundaries.outcome: The existing sidecar and source photo remain unchanged.
The complete new JSON sidecar is visible.

operations.postcommit_cancel: The complete sidecar remains committed; source media is unchanged.
operations.recovery_action: Retry the atomic save; malformed prior sidecars require explicit user repair and are preserved.

operations.commit_model: SQLite operation and per-file intent journal around atomic copy/move/Trash/rename/restore

boundaries.outcome: Requested scope exists durably; no file mutation has started.
The exact original/target pair is durable before mutation.
One file copy/move/Trash/rename/restore is physically complete.
Journal state agrees with the physical file pair.

operations.precommit_cancel: The current file is unchanged; earlier committed files remain reported.
operations.postcommit_cancel: The current committed file remains and is reconciled as restorable where applicable.
operations.committed_subset: Exactly the per-file completed journal rows; partial batch success is explicit.
operations.recovery_action: Compare original/target manifests, reconcile twice idempotently, then explicitly restore eligible changed paths.

operations.commit_model: verified sibling image followed by atomic replace, within the gallery journal

boundaries.outcome: The source image is unchanged and the exact request is journalled.
A complete decodable temporary image exists beside the source.
The full rewritten image is visible at the original path.

operations.postcommit_cancel: The complete verified replacement remains; outcome is reported rather than rolled back silently.
operations.committed_subset: One complete rewritten image per completed journal row.
operations.recovery_action: Reconcile the journal and surface unknown commit outcome for explicit review.

operations.commit_model: verified staging directory replaces target while the complete previous directory remains recoverable

boundaries.outcome: The prior complete target is preserved as previous; staging is still unpublished.
The complete verified new bundle occupies the target path.
Only after publication is the older complete directory removed.

operations.precommit_cancel: Recover the previous complete bundle or retain the verified staging directory.
operations.postcommit_cancel: The newly published complete bundle remains ready.
operations.committed_subset: None: only a complete bundle directory is ready.
operations.recovery_action: Startup selects a complete target/previous/staging bundle and quarantines incomplete content.

operations.commit_model: atomic live-directory detach followed by cancellable staging deletion

boundaries.outcome: The complete old cache remains live.
The old cache is isolated in managed staging and the live path is absent.
A new empty live directory exists while old staging cleanup may remain retryable.

operations.postcommit_cancel: An empty live cache plus named managed staging is reported for retry.
operations.committed_subset: The clear commits at directory detach; physical staging cleanup is separately retryable.
operations.recovery_action: Clear Rebuildable Caches retries only marker-validated managed staging.

operations.commit_model: WAL checkpoint followed by ordered managed SQLite sidecar/main removal

boundaries.outcome: The main SQLite database remains usable.
The rebuildable database is absent and will be recreated lazily.

operations.postcommit_cancel: The rebuildable database remains cleared; no durable user/source data is targeted.
operations.committed_subset: Only the explicitly selected rebuildable SQLite cache family.
operations.recovery_action: Recreate the derived database on next use.

operations.commit_model: marked staging tree with checksummed manifest, then atomic directory publication

boundaries.outcome: Only discoverable marked staging exists; no visible backup is claimed.
A complete checksummed backup is visible and retained.
The source-side journal records completion.

operations.precommit_cancel: Discard only marker-matched staging or retry the backup.
operations.postcommit_cancel: Verify and retain the published backup, then finalize its journal.
operations.committed_subset: None: only a complete verified backup directory is published.
operations.recovery_action: Discover the source-side journal; discard staging or finalize the published backup idempotently.

operations.commit_model: verified marked staging tree, atomic directory publication, then atomic active-root pointer update

boundaries.outcome: The old Data Home remains active and the staged manifest is reusable.
The complete verified target directory is published; the old root remains available.
The next-launch pointer names the published target.

operations.precommit_cancel: Resume the verified staging tree or discard it while keeping the old Data Home active.
operations.postcommit_cancel: Verify the published target and finish the pointer/journal update.
operations.committed_subset: None: a complete verified managed tree is published before activation.
operations.recovery_action: Resume/rollback twice idempotently after validating marker, manifest, source availability and target scope.

operations.commit_model: journalled per-file quarantine followed by an explicit committed removal state

boundaries.outcome: The exact managed DB/WAL/SHM/ANN set is durable before any rename.
The next managed file remains live.
The moved file is recoverable from managed payload staging.
Removal is committed but explicitly restorable/discardable.

operations.precommit_cancel: Restore every staged file and remove the incomplete operation.
operations.postcommit_cancel: Retain committed quarantine and report restore/discard actions.
operations.committed_subset: The exact journalled managed storage family; never source photos or external models.
operations.recovery_action: Recover incomplete staging twice; explicitly restore or discard a committed quarantine.

operations.commit_model: per-path lock plus atomic JSON replace

boundaries.outcome: The current complete record set is retained under the path lock.
One complete valid record set replaces the previous file.

operations.postcommit_cancel: The complete new search set remains.
operations.committed_subset: None: the saved-search file is one complete record set.
operations.recovery_action: Preserve malformed/failed files and retry after explicit repair.

operations.commit_model: SQLite transactions; optional EXIF mirroring is a separate journalled embedded-metadata operation

boundaries.outcome: The previous tag rows remain visible to other connections.
All rows in the requested tag mutation are durable.

operations.precommit_cancel: Roll back the current tag transaction.
operations.postcommit_cancel: Retain and report the complete committed tag mutation.
operations.committed_subset: One complete SQLite transaction; per-photo EXIF results are reported separately.
operations.recovery_action: Reopen SQLite; corrupt databases are preserved with a timestamped backup and a new empty managed DB.

operations.commit_model: atomic JSON result replace keyed by input/model/backend signature

boundaries.outcome: The previous compatible result remains readable.
The complete new result is visible under its exact signature.

operations.precommit_cancel: The previous result or cache miss remains.
operations.postcommit_cancel: The complete new result remains reusable only under the same signature.
operations.committed_subset: None: one complete result JSON is the cache unit.
operations.recovery_action: Reject malformed/incompatible cache content and recompute.
